title: No Menu Logo
description: No Menu Logo is a essential utility for players who prefer a clean, custom GUI experience. By removing the bulky vanilla logo, this pack creates a blank canvas for your main menu, making it perfect for custom GUI
body: **No Menu Logo** is a simple, lightweight resource pack designed to give your main menu a cleaner, more minimalist look. By removing the large Minecraft title logo, it allows you to enjoy your background panoramas or custom UI designs without any obstruction.
